1.text: Tumaze gukira tumenya yuko icyo kirwa cyitwa Melita.

2.text: Bene igihugu batugirira neza cyane, baducanira umuriro, batwakīra twese kuko hari imvura n'imbeho.

3.text: Ariko Pawulo amaze guteranya umuganda w'inkwi arazicana, incira iva mu muriro imuruma ku kiganza.

4.text: Bene igihugu babonye icyo gikururuka kirereta ku gikonjo cye baravugana bati “Ni ukuri uyu muntu ni umwicanyi. Nturora n'ubwo yakize mu nyanja, idaca urwa kibere ntimukundira kubaho!”

5.text: Ariko akunkumurira icyo gikururuka mu muriro, ntiyagira icyo aba.

6.text: Ba bandi bategereza yuko ari bubyimbe cyangwa ari bupfe akindutse, ariko bamaze umwanya munini bakibitegereje, babona nta cyo abaye barahindura bati “Ni imana.”

7.text: Bugufi bw'aho hantu hari igikingi cy'umutware w'icyo kirwa witwaga Pubiliyo, aratwakira atuzimanira neza iminsi itatu.

8.text: Se wa Pubiliyo yari arwaye ubuganga n'amacinya. Nuko Pawulo yinjira mu nzu ye arasenga, amurambikaho ibiganza aramukiza.

9.text: Ibyo bibaye, abandi barwayi bari mu kirwa baherako na bo baraza, arabakiza.

10.text: Baduha icyubahiro cyinshi, kandi tugiye gutsuka bashyira ibyo twari dukennye byose mu nkuge yacu.

11.text: Tumazeyo amezi atatu dutsuka mu nkuge yavuye mu Alekizanderiya, yari imaze amezi y'imbeho ku kirwa, ikimenyetso cyayo cyari ishusho y'Abavandimwe b'Impanga.

12.text: Dufata i Surakusa tumarayo iminsi itatu.

13.text: Bukeye tuvayo, turagoronzoka tugera i Regiyo. Hashize umunsi umwe umuyaga uturutse ikusi urahuha, nuko tugenda iminsi ibiri dufata i Puteyoli.

14.text: Tuhasanga bene Data bamwe, baratwinginga ngo tumarane na bo iminsi irindwi. Nuko tujya i Roma.

15.text: Bene Data b'i Roma bumvise inkuru yacu, baza kudusanganirira mu midugudu yitwa Iguriro rya Apiyo, n'Amatundiro atatu. Pawulo ababonye ashima Imana, ashyitsa agatima mu nda.

16.text: Tumaze kugera i Roma, umutware utwara umutwe ashyikiriza imbohe umutware w'abasirikare barinda Kayisari, ariko bakundira Pawulo kuba ukwe, ari kumwe n'umusirikare umurinda.

17.text: Iminsi itatu ishize ahamagaza abakomeye bo mu Bayuda, bamaze guterana arababwira ati “Bagabo bene Data, nubwo ntagize ikibi nagiriye ubwoko bwacu cyangwa imigenzo ya ba sogokuruza, nabohewe i Yerusalemu, bankurayo bampa Abaroma.

18.text: Na bo bamaze kumbaza bashaka kundekura, kuko nta mpamvu yambonetseho yo kunyicisha.

19.text: Ariko Abayuda bagiye impaka, mpatwa kujuririra kuri Kayisari, icyakora si uko mfite icyo ndega ubwoko bwacu.

20.text: Ni cyo nabatumiriye ngo tuvugane duhanganye, kuko ibyo Abisirayeli bīringira kuzabona, ari byo byatumye mboheshwa uyu munyururu.”

21.text: Na bo baramusubiza bati “Nta nzandiko z'ibyawe twabonye zivuye i Yudaya, kandi na bene Data baje nta wigeza atubarira inkuru mbi yawe, cyangwa ngo akuvuge nabi.

22.text: Ariko turashaka kumva ibyo utekereza, kuko icyo gice tuzi yuko bakivuga nabi hose.”

23.text: Bamusezeranya umunsi, bamusanga ari benshi mu nzu bamucumbikiyemo arabibasobanurira, ahamya ubwami bw'Imana, abemeza ibya Yesu abikuye mu mategeko ya Mose no mu byahanuwe, ahera mu gitondo ageza nimugoroba.

24.text: Bamwe bemera ibyo yavuze, ariko abandi ntibabyemera.

25.text: Ntibahuza imitima, nuko Pawulo abasezeraho amaze kuvuga ijambo rimwe ati “Ibyo Umwuka Wera yabwiriye ba sekuruza wanyu mu kanwa k'umuhanuzi Yesaya,

26.text: yabivuze neza ati‘Jya kuri abo bantu ubabwire utiKumva muzumva ariko ntimuzabimenya,Kureba muzareba ariko ntimuzabyitegereza.

27.text: Kuko umutima w'ubu bwoko ufite ibinure,Amatwi yabo akaba ari ibihuri,Amaso yabo bakayahumiriza,Ngo batarebesha amaso,Batumvisha amatwi,No kumenyesha umutima,No guhindukira,Ngo mbakize.’

28.text: “Nuko mumenye yuko abanyamahanga bohererejwe ako gakiza k'Imana, kandi abo bazakumvira.”[

29.text: Amaze kuvuga atyo, Abayuda bagenda bagishanya impaka cyane.]

30.text: Amara imyaka ibiri itagabanije mu icumbi rye, bamucumbikiyemo kujya atanga ibiguzi. Yākīraga abaje kumusura bose,

31.text: akabwiriza iby'ubwami bw'Imana, akigisha iby'Umwami Yesu Kristo ashize amanga rwose, kandi nta wamubuzaga.
